TYPO_MINIMAL_KILLFEED.name: Esports Clean Stacked Tournament Killfeed
TYPO_MINIMAL_KILLFEED.description: Tournament-standard badges positioned at top-right, appearing frame-locked to lethal bullet hits and auto-stacking.
TYPO_MINIMAL_KILLFEED.editing_technique: High-resolution alpha PNG/SVG badges rendered with soft drop shadow and team color accents.
TYPO_MINIMAL_KILLFEED.suggested_audio_treatment: Synced with hit sound / headshot snap.
TYPO_MINIMAL_KILLFEED.suggested_timing_range: Appears exactly on kill frame, expires 2.5s later

davinci_resolve_recipe.node_tree: Track V2: PNG Overlay with In-Out cut aligned to kill marker.

TYPO_ACE_DOMINATION.name: Climax ACE Domination Victory Banner
TYPO_ACE_DOMINATION.description: Prestigious gold/cyan glowing badge celebrating round-winning 5K Ace, presented during the victory orbit.
visual_prerequisites: Climax camera orbit or victory slow-mo
TYPO_ACE_DOMINATION.editing_technique: Centered lower-third badge with subtle scale breathing (1.0x -> 1.03x) and golden outer bloom.
suggested_transitions: Fade in 0.25s, fade out with video
TYPO_ACE_DOMINATION.suggested_audio_treatment: Heavy sub downer with 2.5s decay into soundtrack vocal hook.
